proof_body:
by
  intro a p q x ha hpq
  rw [mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 : (x - p) * (x - q) < 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      have := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ha.le hn
      linarith
    rcases mul_neg_iff.1 h2 with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · exfalso
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg ha (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) (by linarith))
